caption: Today · Coordinator, short message: the raw Linear address fills the bubble, and the DEV-68 card sits 30px under “just now”, across the whole conversation, as an item of its own.
Today · Coordinator, long message: the address is buried mid-paragraph; the card again comes after the stamp, at full width.
Today · Coordinator, two links: both raw addresses in the words, then two full-width cards under the stamp.
Today · Coordinator, the agent’s link: the coordinator’s “PR #131” is a plain link in its prose; the person’s card floats between the two messages.
Today · Task, short message: in a task’s wider thread the card spans 700px, wider than the bubble it came from.
Today · Task, long message: the address mid-paragraph, the card after the stamp.
Today · Task, two links: two full-width cards under the stamp.
Today · Task, the agent’s link: the lead’s bare address is a plain link in its prose.
A · Coordinator, short: the address becomes the kit’s inline mark and key, “DEV-68”, and the app’s own card sits inside the bubble under the words; the bubble widens to hold it.
A · Coordinator, long: the key reads in place mid-paragraph; the card sits at the bubble’s foot, inside it.
A · Coordinator, two links: “DEV-68” and “#131” in the words, both cards stacked inside the bubble.
A · Coordinator, the agent’s link: the person’s card is inside their grey bubble; the coordinator’s link stays a plain link in its prose.
A · Task, short: one bubble holding the words and the card, at the bubble’s widest.
A · Task, long: the card closes the bubble.
A · Task, two links: both cards inside the bubble.
A · Task, the agent’s link: the person’s card in their bubble, the lead’s link plain.
B · Coordinator, short: the card above the bubble, right-aligned at the bubble’s widest, as what was sent with it; the address stays in the words as typed.
B · Coordinator, long: the card is read before the paragraph that explains it, and the raw address still runs through the words.
B · Coordinator, two links: two cards stacked above the bubble.
B · Coordinator, the agent’s link: the card leads the person’s message; the coordinator’s link plain in its prose.
B · Task, short: card, then bubble, then “just now”.
B · Task, long: the card above a tall bubble.
B · Task, two links: two cards above the bubble.
B · Task, the agent’s link: the person’s card above their bubble, the lead’s link plain.

C · Coordinator, short: the card right under the bubble, in the kit’s own unfurl slot on You, at the bubble’s widest, with “just now” after it: words, card, time, one message. The address stays as typed.
C · Coordinator, long: the card follows the paragraph it belongs to, 6px under it, before the stamp.
C · Coordinator, two links: two cards stacked under the bubble, then the stamp.
C · Coordinator, the agent’s link: the person’s card closes their message on the right; the coordinator’s link plain on the left.
C · Task, short: in the wide thread the card keeps to the bubble’s column.
C · Task, long: the card under the paragraph, before the stamp.
C · Task, two links: two cards under the bubble.
C · Task, the agent’s link: the person’s card under their bubble, the lead’s bare address plain.
C, with A’s keys · Coordinator, two links: the addresses read as “DEV-68” and “#131” in the words, the cards under the bubble.
C, with A’s keys · Task, two links: the same in the wide thread.
D · Coordinator, short: the address becomes a chip in the words (Linear’s mark, DEV-68 and the title, cut to fit); no card until asked.
D · Coordinator, long: the chip mid-paragraph; the bubble stays words only.
D · Coordinator, two links: two chips; in the narrow column the second wraps onto a line of its own and breaks the sentence.
D · Coordinator, the agent’s link: the person’s chip against the coordinator’s plain link.
D · Task, short: one chip at the end of the words.
D · Task, long: the chip in the first line of the paragraph.
D · Task, two links: both chips in one sentence.
D · Task, the agent’s link: the person’s chip, the lead’s plain link.
D · Coordinator, pointing at the DEV-68 chip: the app’s own card opens above it, and goes when the pointer leaves.
D · Task, the #131 chip pressed: its card stays open once the pointer leaves, until a press outside or Escape; pressing the card opens GitHub.
E · Coordinator, short: the address becomes the key in the words; under the bubble, before “just now”, one quiet line: Linear’s mark, DEV-68, the title, Todo, and an arrow (it opens Linear).
E · Coordinator, long: the key in the paragraph, the line at the bubble’s foot.
E · Coordinator, two links: one line per link, right-aligned like the bubble, each with where it stands (Todo, Merged).
E · Coordinator, the agent’s link: the person’s line under their bubble, the coordinator’s plain link.
E · Task, short: one line under the bubble.
E · Task, long: the line closes the message.
E · Task, two links: two lines, the title cut to fit the bubble’s width.
E · Task, the agent’s link: the person’s line, the lead’s plain link.
